prompt:

One continuous world: the same desk, the same person and the same laptop appear in all three panels, and they read left to right as one progression.

In every panel: a glowing translucent amber laptop sits on a warm wooden desk. The action happens INSIDE the laptop screen, where one small rounded agent figure works. The human is OUTSIDE the laptop in the warm real world, and only their hands and forearms enter the frame.

BEAT TWO (middle panel): The same stack, with the same brass marker bar still fixed at the same height. A single new sheet of paper drifts down toward the top of the stack and STOPS DEAD against the underside of the brass bar, held in the air, unable to land. The stack below the bar is completely undisturbed. The agent holds the blocked sheet at arm's length.

BEAT THREE (right panel): The same stack is now visibly SHORTER, because the human's hand outside has drawn a small sheaf of papers out of the laptop and set them on the wooden desk. Physical relationships, stated explicitly: the brass marker is a horizontal bar fixed at one height across the stack. Paper already below the bar is undisturbed and stays. Paper arriving from above touches the bar's underside and cannot pass it. The bar moves down only, never up.

ABSOLUTELY NOT: a denim jacket, a jean jacket, any chest patch, any smiley-face badge, any enamel pin, any embroidered emblem, a white tee under an open jacket. No recurring branded character and no identifiable real individual.

no comic-book, no cartoon mascot, no flat vector, no neon, no 3D/CGI/Pixar, no photoreal, no anime, no identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing.

Caption in the cream gutter directly BELOW the left panel: "MARK THE CURRENT HEIGHT" in caps. Caption in the cream gutter directly BELOW the middle panel: "NEW WORK CANNOT EXCEED IT" in caps. Caption in the cream gutter directly BELOW the right panel: "THE MARK ONLY MOVES DOWN" in caps. Footer bar: "GRANDFATHER THE DEBT. BLOCK THE NEXT ONE." in caps, centered in the cream margin BELOW the captions. All text sits in the cream margins, never over the artwork. No other text anywhere.

warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults
